protocol.name: osa_ai_v1
protocol.description:
This protocol allows the AI command palette and other AI-aware applications to communicate with the osa-compositor.
It provides events for AI panel visibility, model status, and inference progress, allowing applications to react to the AI state of the desktop.

interface.name: osa_ai_manager_v1
interface.description: Global singleton for managing the AI overlay panel. Obtained via wl_registry.

request.name: toggle_panel
request.description: Toggle the AI command palette overlay on/off.

request.name: submit_query

description.summary: Submit a query to the AI

request.description: Send a natural language query to the AI router.

request.name: get_status
request.description: Request the current AI system status (model loaded, inference state).

event.name: panel_state
event.description: Sent when the AI panel is shown or hidden.

event.name: model_status
event.description: Sent when the active model changes or inference state changes.

event.name: response_chunk
event.description: Sent during streaming inference with partial response text.
